response.justification: The candidate brings valuable geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map work, plus systems programming background from Dunnhumby media and extensive D language projects. However, the role requires modern C++ as primary tech, with last substantial C++ work in 2015; currently focused on TypeScript/Node.js. More critically, he lacks direct experience building routing systems or optimizing routing tile pipelines. While strong learning ability and infrastructure knowledge are assets, technical and domain experience gaps are significant for a mid-senior IC role requiring immediate production contributions.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map work, directly relevant to routing tile systems
Systems programming background with proven ability to build low-latency, high-performance applications and handle millions of requests per second
Strong learning ability and full-stack versatility demonstrated across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming domains
concerns: C++ skills significantly outdated (last used 2015); currently focused on TypeScript/Node.js rather than systems programming
No demonstrated experience building routing engines, optimizing tile pipelines, or implementing navigation guidance systems
Limited evidence of operating and maintaining critical production data pipelines with fault tolerance and consistency requirements
